stories.title: Flintshire Standards Committee reports ‘growing antagonism’ at council meetings
stories.summary: Flintshire’s standards watchdog says behaviour between councillors has deteriorated over the past year, with growing antagonism inside meetings and online. The finding comes in the Standards Committee’s draft annual report for 2025/26, which goes before the committee next Monday evening and then to Full Council. stories.title: Tarmac seek permission to fix fault line issue after Hendre Quarry land slip
stories.summary: A limestone quarry which sits on a fault line in Flintshire which caused a land slip could be stabilised if owners Tarmac are granted planning permission. stories.title: Mold café The Gathering announces immediate closure
stories.summary: The Gathering Coffee Shop & Bistro in Mold has closed permanently with immediate effect. stories.title: Planning officer rejects defibrillator outside Mold building society over listed building setting
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has refused Nationwide permission for a defibrillator and bleed kit cabinet on the front of its Mold branch, ruling the defibrillator would harm the setting of the Grade II listed building next door. stories.title: Transport for Wales brings bus network proposals to Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell this month
stories.summary: People in Flintshire can question Transport for Wales about its proposed new bus network at four drop-in sessions this month, starting at Mold Library and Museum on Wednesday.
